title: Reduce Completed review helper exports
summary: Removed twelve transitional flat window.* aliases for Completed review helper functions while preserving the same functions on window.mediaPipelineCompletedView.
reason: Continue the namespace-first WebView cleanup stream with a scoped Completed-domain change that keeps existing rendered behavior and intentional entry points intact.
behavior_before: Completed review helper status/line functions for integrity, breakdown, runtime, consistency, validation, and workflow were available both through window.mediaPipelineCompletedView and as direct window.* flat aliases.
behavior_after: Those review helper functions remain available through window.mediaPipelineCompletedView, while the direct flat aliases are removed; Completed render and selected-row entry points remain unchanged.
tests_added: Updated tests/webview/test_webview_browser_completed_pending_proof_smoke.py to require the removed helper names through mediaPipelineCompletedView and to assert the served Completed source no longer assigns those flat aliases.
rollback_plan: Revert this change packet to restore the twelve direct window.* aliases, regenerate the WebView public contract baseline and summaries, and restore the prior flat export counts in docs/CURRENT_PROJECT_STATE.md and docs/inventories/WEBVIEW_GLOBAL_EXPORT_INVENTORY.md.
